scope.mode: read-only repository review; authorized temporary report written

findings.title: Target-only load gates conflated stored MTP weights with required target residents
findings.original_issue: Initial load rows audited main/MTP residency and Flash G53F-01 treated missing MTP groups as a promotion blocker before speculation. The pinned target loaders intentionally omit speculative tensors.

supporting_sources.observation: MTP/nextn weights are skipped by the target loader and loaded by the MTP model.
Speculative layers are deliberately skipped for the main model.
Target weight mapping filters mtp. weights.

findings.registration_confirmation: GLM 5.3 pinned config declares GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM; registry.py:120 maps it to vllm.models.deepseek_v32; that module __init__.py:17-21 aliases the CUDA DeepseekV32ForCausalLM; nvidia/model.py:427-433 selects DeepseekV32Model.
findings.resolution: All three final plans now separate stored completeness from resident target inventory, explicitly allow documented draft exclusions, reject missing required target/vision/PLE components, and require MTP tensors/scales/effective precision during speculative-arm qualification.

findings.title: Flash PD comparison needed explicit MoE backend control
findings.original_issue: Current cookbook mechanical PD example uses triton MoE and identifies flashinfer_trtllm as untested under PD; the stored target-only profile uses flashinfer_trtllm. Connector and dtype controls alone did not expose this changed backend.

supporting_sources.observation: Dummy-weight validation used triton; flashinfer_trtllm is untested under PD.

findings.resolution: Final applicability row names the Triton mechanical path and untested FlashInfer path; G53F-06 requires exact-runner qualification and matched colocated/split runner where supported, otherwise a declared combined backend/PD comparison.

NVIDIA Qwen max_new_tokens=131072 and reasoning_effort=xhigh source settings cannot fit a 65536-total-context reproduction setup; final plan labels this correctly.

Service shapes 4096/16384/32768/61440 serialized input plus 128/1024 output and 4096+8192 reasoning shape fit 65536; multimodal/template/reasoning counting and separate extended-context gates are explicit.

RULER v1 route and NeMo-Skills dependency are pinned before execution; DocVQA single-document ANLS is the correct named metric; local multi-image cases and SWE-bench agent campaigns are separated from those official scores.
Target-only versus speculation, export quality versus topology, equal-node resource comparisons, and scored quality versus lightweight timing artifacts are distinguished.
